**EU unlocks 710 mn euros' aid for crisis-hit communities: RFI**

European Commission president Ursula von der Leyen announced the package on Saturday in a statement to the UN General Assembly, saying most of it is for Africa and that it will support displaced communities there and the communities welcoming them.
